description:
Reentrancy in LummyEscrow._pull(address,uint256,uint256,uint256,bytes32,bytes) (src/LummyEscrow.sol#343-355):
	External call allowing reentrancy:
	- IERC3009(address(TOKEN)).receiveWithAuthorization(from,address(this),value,validAfter,validBefore,authNonce,erc3009Sig) (src/LummyEscrow.sol#352-353)
	Balance read before the call:
	- before = TOKEN.balanceOf(address(this)) (src/LummyEscrow.sol#351)
	Possible stale balance used after the call in a condition:
	- TOKEN.balanceOf(address(this)) - before < value (src/LummyEscrow.sol#354)
		- stale variable `before`

LummyEscrow._windowClosed(LummyEscrow.Listing) (src/LummyEscrow.sol#372-374) uses timestamp for comparisons
	Dangerous comparisons:
	- L.status == Status.DisputeWindow && ! L.disputed && block.timestamp > _deadline(L) (src/LummyEscrow.sol#373)

LummyEscrow.fund(bytes32,address,uint256,uint256,uint256,bytes32,bytes,uint256,bytes) (src/LummyEscrow.sol#153-178) uses timestamp for comparisons
	Dangerous comparisons:
	- block.timestamp > deadline (src/LummyEscrow.sol#167)

LummyEscrow.release(bytes32) (src/LummyEscrow.sol#232-241) uses timestamp for comparisons
	Dangerous comparisons:
	- block.timestamp <= _deadline(L) (src/LummyEscrow.sol#236)

LummyLedger._windowClosed(LummyLedger.Order) (src/LummyLedger.sol#216-218) uses timestamp for comparisons
	Dangerous comparisons:
	- ! O.disputed && block.timestamp > _deadline(O) (src/LummyLedger.sol#217)

LummyLedger.release(bytes32) (src/LummyLedger.sol#164-172) uses timestamp for comparisons
	Dangerous comparisons:
	- block.timestamp <= _deadline(O) (src/LummyLedger.sol#168)

MockUSDC._receive(address,address,uint256,uint256,uint256,bytes32,bytes) (src/MockUSDC.sol#73-97) uses timestamp for comparisons
	Dangerous comparisons:
	- block.timestamp <= validAfter (src/MockUSDC.sol#83)
	- block.timestamp >= validBefore (src/MockUSDC.sol#84)
